sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.

sections.text: KDM5A encodes a histone H3 lysine-4 demethylase and chromatin reader.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 5927 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record

sections.text: NUP98::KDM5A is a recurrent AML fusion retaining the amino-terminal NUP98 region. The cohort showed dysregulated HOX expression across NUP98 fusion groups.

audit_evidence.location: Results: Clinical characteristics; Implications of variation of fusion junction; Differential gene expression; Figures 1,2,4
audit_evidence.scope: Pair detection, amino-terminal FG-region representation and cohort HOX transcription; no asserted function of every retained partner domain.

sections.text: In the pediatric COG cohort, NUP98::KDM5A AML was associated with inferior overall and event-free survival compared with the non-NUP98 reference group.

audit_evidence.location: Results: Clinical outcome and prognostic relevance; Figure 6A/B and multivariable analysis, lines 217-223
audit_evidence.scope: Observed pediatric cohort outcome; KDM5A outcomes varied with chromosome-13/junction subgroup.

report_comment.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation. KDM5A encodes a histone H3 lysine-4 demethylase and chromatin reader. NUP98::KDM5A is a recurrent AML fusion retaining the amino-terminal NUP98 region. The cohort showed dysregulated HOX expression across NUP98 fusion groups. In the pediatric COG cohort, NUP98::KDM5A AML was associated with inferior overall and event-free survival compared with the non-NUP98 reference group.
